paper_trading.plan: One Alpaca paper account per strategy (PAPER_TRADING_PLAN.md). Started early to test the order plumbing; pass/fail verdicts still come from the shadow trackers. Account values are read from Alpaca at each run (see 'As of'); Alpaca's own page is live, so it will differ between runs.

earnings.rule: EPS surprise >= 50% (S&P 1500 + Russell 2000), buy the reaction-session open, sell the close 20 sessions later; vs every tracked reporter the same week; cost 0.10% / 0.40%.
earnings.pass_bar: mean excess after cost >= +0.5% with 95% CI lower bound > -0.5% (judged on completed events)
earnings.next_decision: First read mid-to-late Nov 2026; fuller read early Dec
earnings.watch_arms_note: atr_high / accumulation thirds are computed at review time (need pre-event price bars).

momentum.rule: S&P 1500, 12-1 month return at the last close of the month, top decile (price >= $5, 20d $vol >= $5M), equal weight, first open of the month to the next month's first open. PAPER BOOK = top 1% of eligible (~13-15 names, momentum_book_size_study.py); decile/top20/top30 tracked alongside; watch-only (momentum_lever_study.py, rejected but close in the fair test): risk-adjusted ranking and a 3-per-sector cap, top-1% sized.
momentum.next_decision: Review after 12 scored months (~Oct 2027); paper trading planned Nov/Dec 2026

product_events.rule: AAPL: buy the close 21 sessions before a projected iPhone keynote / WWDC session, sell the close the session before. Non-Apple megacaps are watch-only.
product_events.next_decision: Review after 6 primary events (~mid-2028): mean abnormal run-up > 0 with >= 4/6 positive

brand_trends.rule: 103 consumer brands; every 2 weeks buy the top decile by YoY Google search growth (last 13 weeks vs a year earlier), hold 6 months, vs the equal-weight brand pool.
brand_trends.status: Monitoring only. Original backtest passed; survivorship-free S&P 500 re-test failed (+1.39%/6mo, CI spans 0). Keep or cut decided from the biweekly reports.
brand_trends.next_decision: Formal review at 12 cohorts with 6-month marks (~Oct 2027); interim reads every 2 weeks

teen_survey.rule: Brand with a US-listed parent newly in the Piper Sandler upper-income teen top 5 (clothing/footwear); buy 5 trading days after the release, hold 6 months vs XLY.
teen_survey.status: Monitoring only; survey is annual (October). Backtest (descriptive): +12.9% vs XLY, n=21.
